make controller-deploy    # Deploy controller manager

actions.resource: providers/<provider> directory; make deploy target with IMG=<image>

actions.excerpt:
hf_token_file="$(mktemp)"
trap 'rm -f "$hf_token_file"' EXIT

read -r -s -p "Enter HuggingFace token: " hf_token
printf '\n'
printf '%s' "$hf_token" > "$hf_token_file"
chmod 600 "$hf_token_file"
unset hf_token

kubectl create secret generic hf-token \\
  --from-file=token="$hf_token_file" \\
  -n <namespace> \\
  --dry-run=client -o yaml | kubectl apply -f -
actions.reason: Reads a token and creates a cluster secret; namespace is a placeholder and execution is not established.
actions.resource: Interactive HuggingFace token input, stored in a temporary file and submitted as Kubernetes Secret hf-token in <namespace>

actions.excerpt:
kubectl apply -f - <<EOF
apiVersion: airunway.ai/v1alpha1
kind: ModelDeployment
metadata:
  name: <model-name>
  namespace: <namespace>
spec:
  model:
    id: <model-id>
    huggingFaceTokenSecretRef:
      name: hf-token
      key: token
  provider:
    name: <provider-name>
EOF
actions.reason: Applies a gated-model custom resource; all model, provider, name, and namespace values are placeholders.
actions.resource: Kubernetes ModelDeployment named <model-name> in <namespace>, using <model-id> and <provider-name>

actions.excerpt:
ENDPOINT=$(kubectl get modeldeployment <model-name> -n <namespace> -o jsonpath='{.status.endpoint}')

if [ -z "$ENDPOINT" ]; then
  echo "Endpoint not yet available — model may still be starting"
else
  curl -X POST "${ENDPOINT}/v1/chat/completions" \\
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\
    -d '{"model": "<model-id>", "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "Hello!"}]}'
fi
actions.reason: Sends a chat-completion POST if the dynamically retrieved endpoint is nonempty; endpoint and identifiers are unresolved placeholders.
actions.resource: ${ENDPOINT}/v1/chat/completions, where ENDPOINT is read from ModelDeployment <model-name> in <namespace>

SERVICE_PORT=$(kubectl get svc <service-name> -n <namespace> -o jsonpath='{.spec.ports[0].port}')

kubectl port-forward svc/<service-name> 8080:${SERVICE_PORT} -n <namespace> &
> # Then use http://localhost:8080 as the endpoint

actions.excerpt:
kubectl create secret generic hf-token `
  --from-file=token="$env:TEMP\hf-token.txt" `
  -n <namespace> `
  --dry-run=client -o yaml | kubectl apply -f -

Remove-Item -Force "$env:TEMP\hf-token.txt"
